title: Repeatable AI Workflows: How to Describe a Task So It Is Done the Same Way Every Time

cards.heading: Aim for the same kind of result
cards.text: AI-assisted work varies a little each run. Aim for consistent structure, tone and quality, then check it.

cards.heading: Describe five parts of the task
cards.text: Write down the input, the steps, the format, the rules and who checks the result.

cards.heading: Collect good and awkward examples
cards.text: Three to five past examples show what good looks like before anything is run.

cards.heading: Flag gaps instead of guessing
cards.text: Decide in advance what happens when information is missing, unclear or contradictory.

cards.heading: Keep a note of every change
cards.text: Record what changed and when, and let one person approve edits to the task description.

facebook.message:
Do you have a job that gets done differently every time someone does it?
Our new guide explains how to describe a recurring task so AI-assisted work comes out consistent:
• Write down the input, steps, format, rules and checks
• Collect good examples, and a few awkward ones
• Decide what should happen when information is missing
Swipe through for the key points.
